metadata.title: Urban Mixtape Cover with Figurative Subject

retrievalProfile.description: A minimalist urban composition featuring a full-length figurative subject against a textured neutral wall with expressive, thin-stroke handwritten titles.
excludeWhen: clean sans-serif corporate layouts are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A vertical full-body figure stands against a desaturated, textured plaster wall. The lighting is soft and directional, creating subtle shadows. To the left, thin-line handwritten text is stacked vertically, providing a raw, DIY urban feel.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned on the right third of the frame
Textual elements clustered in the upper left quadrant
Neutral wall texture providing a gritty backdrop
High contrast between dark subject hair/shoes and light wall
coreInvariants: Thin-stroke monolinear handwriting for the primary title
Desaturated, muted color palette dominated by greys and skin tones
Minimalist interior setting with visible floorboard and wall details

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-length figure occupying the right vertical third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central torso of the figure and the large script 'S' in the title.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large script on the left, move down the text stack, then across to the vertical figure.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant empty wall space in the center and lower left to balance the composition.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for hair, shoes, and typography
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm skin tones of the central figure
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the dark subject and light background.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Extended horizontal bars on 't' or 'f' equivalents
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pair expressive script with a small, wide-tracked sans-serif for secondary metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the raw, personal feel of the original lettering
Maintains the consistent line weight seen in the reference

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photo of a person standing against a textured, desaturated grey plaster wall in a minimalist room with dark wooden floors.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply thin-stroke, black handwritten script in the upper left quadrant with a secondary line of small, spaced-out sans-serif text below it.

verificationChecks: Is the text monolinear and handwritten?
Is the background desaturated and textured?
Is the figure positioned to the right side?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible despite the handwritten style
Check that the wall texture does not obscure the thin text strokes
Verify the figure is grounded on the floor plane
Confirm the color palette remains muted and urban
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [textured neutral wall] + [asymmetrical figurative subject] + [thin-stroke monolinear script] to create an urban music aesthetic.
